versions.changelog:
Initial release of immersive-presentations:

- Create cinematic, narrative, interactive web presentations as guided experiences instead of conventional slide decks.
- Structure presentations as scenes and acts with visual storytelling, interactive exploration, and persistent visual objects.
- Provide detailed planning requirements, interaction models, presenter/debug controls, and responsive layouts.
- Reference modular guidance for narrative design, motion integration, accessibility, and anti-patterns.
- For motion, recommend use of the gsap-motion skill when available; fall back to direct implementation as needed.
